analysis.title: Cloudflare (NET) 3Q26: Secular tailwinds from agentic traffic and security converge to drive acceleration
key_insights: GS says NET is indicated +14% after 3Q26. Revenue was 6% above the Street and accelerated about 3.5pp to 39% y/y. Non-GAAP EPS was 11% above the Street (FactSet).
4Q revenue was guided to +37.5% y/y, 6% above the Street, and EPS was guided 13% above the Street (FactSet).

Cloudflare cited broad-based strength across products and customers. It said agentic traffic is picking up, including developers building agents on its Workers platform, up from 7mn in 2Q to 10mn in 3Q.
Cloudflare said it has differentiated security solutions for new agentic web attacks.
Customers are using up pool-of-funds commitments sooner. This leads to earlier renewals and larger subsequent pools.
Cloudflare believes Act IV, its new internet business model for agent-to-content monetization, could become its largest business over a 10-year horizon. It recognized its first Act IV revenue in 3Q.

Act IV has two emerging models: helping AI platforms access content more efficiently, and micropayments that compensate content owners when agents access their sites. Scaled monetization is earlier stage.
Cloudflare said that monetizing even 10% of agent transactions could require a billing engine handling about 10bn transactions per second, versus about 80K for payments rails today.
GS keeps a Buy rating and raises the 12-month price target to $420 from $389, based on 32x Q5-Q8 revenue forecasts (34x previously, on slightly lower peer multiples).
GS raised revenue estimates to $2,964mn/$3,951mn/$5,172mn for 2026E/2027E/2028E from $2,868mn/$3,766mn/$4,866mn. EPS estimates rose to $1.35/$1.97/$2.83 from $1.25/$1.71/$2.41.
GS raised 2026E/2027E/2028E FCF estimates to $471mn/$576mn/$794mn from $435mn/$559mn/$771mn.

market_movers.rationale: GS raised the target to $420 from $389 and kept Buy after 3Q26 revenue 6% above the Street. The target is 32x Q5-Q8 revenue forecasts and implies 71.8% upside from $244.51.

earnings_insights: 3Q26 revenue (reported) $783mn vs GSe $737mn and Street $737mn, 6.2% above both. Growth was 39% y/y vs GSe 31.1% and Street 31.2%.
3Q26 non-GAAP diluted EPS (reported) $0.38 vs GSe $0.35 and Street $0.34, 9.6% above GSe and 11.5% above the Street.
3Q26 adjusted operating income (reported) $137mn vs GSe $130mn and Street $129mn. Margin 18% in line with both. Growth was 60% y/y vs GSe 51% and Street 50%.
3Q26 gross profit (reported) $567mn vs GSe $541mn and Street $541mn. Gross margin 72% vs GSe 74% and Street 73%.
3Q26 free cash flow (reported) was $82mn, vs GSe $71mn and Street $86mn. FCF margin was 10% vs GSe 10% and Street 12%.
4Q26 revenue guidance is +37.5% y/y, 6% above the Street. 4Q26 EPS guidance is 13% above the Street (FactSet).
GS FY estimates (GS forecast): revenue growth 36.7% in 2026E, 33.3% in 2027E and 30.9% in 2028E. EPS (diluted, pre-exceptionals) $1.35/$1.97/$2.83.
risk_factors: Timing of new productivity ramps and potential disruption in the sales organization as Cloudflare expands into enterprise.
Inference demand potentially being met by hyperscalers or other compute solutions.
Scaled agent-to-content monetization (Act IV) is earlier stage, and micropayments at internet scale need significant engineering differentiation.
vol_and_positioning: The stock is indicated +14% post-earnings. Price performance as of 5 Nov 2026 close: absolute -16.5% over 3m, 0.0% over 6m and +7.0% over 12m. Relative to the S&P 500: -16.2%, -5.6% and -5.4%.
